name: How long does carpet installation typically take?
description: Most carpet installations for a single room can be completed within one day, while larger projects may take two to three days depending on preparation needs.

mainEntity.name: How long does carpet installation typically take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of carpet installation depends on the size of the area, the type of carpet, and any necessary subfloor preparation. A standard room (around 200-300 sq ft) can often be completed in a single day. Larger or multiple rooms, or areas requiring extensive old carpet removal or subfloor repairs, may take two to three days. Our team will provide a detailed timeline after assessing your specific project.
